paite: Huan hiaite apipute uh inkote lak a alupente ahi ua, kumpipa Artaksarses vaihawm lai a kei hon zuite khangthu suina ahi.
heading: Saltanna A Kipan A Hong Kik Nawnte

paite: Phinehas tapate lak ah, Gershom: Ithamar tapate lak ah Daniel: David tapate lak ah, Hattush,
Shekaniah tapate lak ah; Parosh tapate lak ah, Zekariah: amah toh pasalte khangthu suina a suikhawmte zakhat-le-sawmnga ahi.
Pahath-moab tapate lak ah, Elihoenai Zerahiah tapa; huan amah toh pasal zanihte.
Shekaniah tapate lak ah, Jahaziel tapa; amah toh pasal zathumte.
Adin tapate lak ah, Jonathan tapa Ebed; amah toh pasal sawmngate.
Elam tapate lak ah, Athaliah tapa Jeshaiah; amah toh pasal sawmsagihte.
Shephatiah tapate, Mikael tapa Zebadiah; amah toh pasal sawmgiatte.
Joab tapate lak ah, Jehiel tapa Obadiah; amah toh pasal zanih sawm-le-giatte.
Shelomith tapate lak ah, Josiphiah tapa; amah toh pasal zakhat-le-sawmgukte.
Bebai tapate lak ah, Bebai tapa Zekariah; amah toh pasal sawmnih-le-giatte.
Azgad tapate lak ah, Hakkatan tapa Johanan; amah toh pasal za-le-sawmte.
Adonikam tapate lak ah, ananungpente; hiaite amin uh ahi, Eliphelet, Jeiel, Shemaiah leh amau toh pasal sawmgukte.
Bigvai tapate, Uthai leh Zabbud; amau toh pasal sawmsagihte.
Huchi in Ahava pha a luang luipi tan in amaute ka kaikhawm a; huai ah ni thum ka giak uhi. Mite leh siampute ka en vialvial a, huai ah Levi tapate kuamah ka mu kei.
heading: Tempul A Ding Levi Mi Ezra In Amu

paite: Huan Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zekariah leh Meshullam, mikizen tungtuante, sinsak mite Joiarib leh Elnathan leng ka thukhak hi.

Kasiphia mun a Iddo hausapa kiang ah amau ka sawlkhia a; Iddo kiang ah leh Kasiphia mun a a-unaute Nethinimte kiang a agen ding uh ka hilh a, i Pathian inn ua ding a nasemmi ei a dia hon tonpih ding in.
Huchi in i tung ua i Pathian khut hoih a om dungzui in pasal khat lunggelsiam, Mahli tapate lak a, Levi tapa, Israel tapa ei ding in Sherebiah atapate leh a-unaute, sawm-le-giat toh ahon pi uhi.
Hashabiah, amah toh Merari tapate lak a Jeshaiah toh, a-unaute leh atapate uh, sawmnih toh;
Nethinimte, David leh avaihawmpihte'n Levi mite nasepna ding a apiakte uh, zanih-le-sawmnih Nethinimte: avek un minkhumna ah akhum uhi.

Huchi in huai ah, Ahava lui ah, an ngawl ka puang a, huchi a ei a ding leh i nau neute a ding leh i neih i lamte tengteng a dia lampi tang amah lak a zong ding a i Pathian uh ma a ei leh ei i kiniamkhiak theihna ding in.
heading: Ezra In Mipite Thumna Leh An Ngawlna Ah Amakaih

paite: Lampi a melma dou ding a ei hon panpih ding a kumpipa kiang a sepaih pawl leh sakol tungtuangmi nget lah ka zum ngal a: hoihna ding a, amah zongte tung ah i Pathian khut a-om a; himahleh amah mangngilh tengteng siatna ding in athilhihtheihna leh athangpaihna a-om hi, chi a, kumpipa kiang a thu i gen tak ziak in.
An i ngawl ua hiai ding in i Pathian i ngen ngutngut ua: huchi in ama'n i thumna uh hon dawng hi.
Huai lai in siampute lak a amakai lianpente lak a sawm-le-nih, Sherebiah, Hashabiah leh akiang ua om a-unaute uh lak a sawmkhat ka sehkhen a,
heading: Tempul A Dia Thilpiak

paite: amau a ding in dangka leh dangka-eng leh tui-um belsuante, kumpipa leh athuhilh mite leh avaihawmpihte'n TOUPA' inn a alatte uh huai lai a om Israel tengteng puak ding in ka buksak hi.
Akhut sung mahmah uah dangka talent zaguk-le-sawmnga leh dangka tui-um belsuan talent za ka buksak a; dangka-eng lak ah talent za;
dangka-eng noubem sawmnih, darik sangkhat lak ah; dal hoih nawttet, dangka-eng bang a manpha bel nih.
Huan akiang uah, "TOUPA a ding in na siangthou ua, tui-um belsuante asiangthou uh; dangka leh dangka-eng TOUPA, na pipute uh Pathian a dia ut thu a thillat ahi uh.
TOUPA' inn dantante, Jerusalem a siampute lak a lupente leh Levi mite leh Israel pipute inko vaihawmte ma a huaite na buk masiah uh, pilvan suah in, amaute kem un," ka chi hi.
Huchi in siampute leh Levi mite'n i Pathian inn ua Jerusalem a apuak ding un dangka leh dangka-eng leh tui-um belsuan bukkhiakte ala uhi.

Huai lai in Jerusalem lam a pai ding in, akha khatna ani sawm-le-nih ni in Ahava lui a kipan i pawtkhia ua: huan i Pathian khut i tung uah a-om a, melma khut leh lampi a buk mi a kipan ama'n hon tankheta hi.
heading: Jerusalem A Tun Kik Nawnna

paite: Huchi in Jerusalem i tung ua huai ah ni thum i om uhi.

Ani li ni in dangka leh dangka-eng leh tui-um belsuan i Pathian inn uah Uriah siampu tapa Meremoth khut ah buk in a-om a; akiang ah Phinehas tapa Eleazar a om; akiang uah Jeshua tapa Jozabad leh Binnui tapa Noadiah, Levi mite a-om uhi;
aphazah leh agikdan tengteng sim ahi a, huai hun in laibu a chiamteh ahi.

Pimangna a kipan a hong pai, saltanna tate'n Israel' Pathian kiang ah halmang thillatte, bawngtal sawm-le-nih Israel tengteng a ding in, belamtal sawmkua-le-guk, belamnou sawmsagih-le-sagih, keltal khelhna thillat ding in sawm-le-nih alan uhi: hiaite tengteng TOUPA a ding a halmang thillat ahi.
Kumpipa thukhen mite kiang leh tuipi khen a ukpipate kiang ah kumpipa thupiakte apekhia ua: huchi in mite leh Pathian inn apanpih uhi.
